title: Hanford passes 30 receipt completeness and reason-code checks
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: Every Hanford receipt template passes a complete synthetic case and rejects missing required fields or decision-incompatible reason codes. Denominator: 30 fixture-only integrity cases across 6 templates; zero failures and zero actual receipts.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Hanford reviewer authorization, receipt integrity, and publication handoff controls.
